instruction: Create a text file named 'image_list.txt' on the Desktop that contains the full paths of all image files (.jpg and .png) in the 'photos' directory, with one path per line.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a text file listing all image files. Verified by checking config: 4 JPG files (monk...jpg, hong-kong-china.jpg, hk_group_photo.jpg, emnlp2023.jpg) + 1 PNG file (us_3.png) = 5 total image files. Expected: 5 lines in image_list.txt.
